primary: Yield of previously unseen material or mate witnesses at a 25% per-family shortlist budget, rounded up.
promotionScreen: At least two additional witnesses against the best simpler equal-budget control, at least two held-out event families improved and no more narrow negatives. Independently check any added witness before an app experiment. More data and an independent live-classifier replay are required for deployment.
policy: An uncertain score consumes a slot and is excluded from average precision. The reference is a bounded engine teacher, not a comprehensive tactical or positional diagnosis.
enrichedDesign: Preserve the model and test budget. Sample fresh events and prioritize pre-existing centipawn losses of at least 140 without using the target Stockfish frames.
